qa-planner.description: Product QA Planner: explores the running target app over the Playwright MCP and reads the API schema, then produces a prioritized structured test plan. Reliability rules and grounding come from agent_config/qa_system_prompt.md.

qa-generator.description: Product QA Generator: consumes the Planner's plan and authors executable TypeScript Playwright UI + API tests, grounded in observed DOM snapshots and the API schema. Reliability rules and grounding come from agent_config/qa_system_prompt.md.
